<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518913794_theRebbe_460" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518913794_theRebbe_460__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the mitzvah of the day on Rosh Hashanah is the shofar, which draws down the revelation of the two trumpets, representing the unification of G-d and Israel through the soul's root in Atzmus, culminating in the ultimate purpose of a dwelling place for the Awtsmoos in this lowly world.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">e)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is “And on the day of your rejoicing… and you shall sound with trumpets… I am the L-rd your G-d.”</t>
    <t s="2">“And you shall sound” refers to the sounding of the shofar,</t>
    <t s="3">for the mitzvah of the day</t>
    <t s="4">(Rosh Hashanah)</t>
    <t s="5">is with the shofar,</t>
    <t s="6">as it is stated in the Mishnah:</t>
    <t s="7">The shofar is prolonged and the trumpets are shortened, for the mitzvah of the day is with the shofar.</t>
    <t s="8">And through this, the matter of the trumpets is also drawn down and revealed,</t>
    <t s="9">that the Holy One, blessed be He, and Israel are two halves of a form,</t>
    <t s="10">meaning that Israel are rooted in His very Essence (Atzmus) and they determine the will</t>
    <t s="11">(as above, regarding “Whom did He consult? The souls of the righteous”),</t>
    <t s="12">and from the determined will it is drawn to the revealed will, etc., until it is drawn down below in this world,</t>
    <t s="13">and this is the main point.</t>
    <t s="14">That is, the drawing down through all the levels—</t>
    <t s="15">delight, will, intellect, emotions, and kingship, etc.—is an intermediary through which it is then drawn down into this world.</t>
    <t s="16">And as explained in the holy Tanya,</t>
    <t s="17">that in the entire order of the chain of descent, it is a descent from the light of His countenance,</t>
    <t s="18">and the ultimate intention is this lowly world, below which there is no lower,</t>
    <t s="19">a deep pit,</t>
    <t s="20">specifically in it</t>
    <t s="21">(in this lowly world)</t>
    <t s="22">was man created and in it was given the soul, literally a part of G-d from above,</t>
    <t s="23">and through his service in Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="24">(“to work it and to guard it”)</t>
    <t s="25">the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed,</t>
    <t s="26">a dwelling place for His Essence and Being,</t>
    <t s="27">so that “these are the generations of Peretz, Peretz is written fully,”</t>
    <t s="28">which is higher even than it was at the beginning of creation, for “the world was created in its fullness,”</t>
    <t s="29">“Peretz begot… Dovid,”</t>
    <t s="30">Dovid, the King Messiah,</t>
    <t s="31">who will build the Holy Temple,</t>
    <t s="32">and it will be “and you shall sound with trumpets… before your G-d,”</t>
    <t s="33">“with trumpets and the sound of the shofar, shout before the King, the L-rd,”</t>
    <t s="34">literally</t>
    <t s="35">(in the Holy Temple)</t>
    <t s="36">below ten handbreadths.</t>
    <t s="37">For through the service during the time of exile, “sound the shofar at the new moon,”</t>
    <t s="38">“improve your deeds,”</t>
    <t s="39">and in a novel manner, as the precise wording of the verse “sound at the new moon a shofar”</t>
    <t s="40">(and not “sound a shofar at the new moon”),</t>
    <t s="41">as is known the explanation of the Baal Shem Tov</t>
    <t s="42">on this,</t>
    <t s="43">through this is brought about the matter of “make for yourself two trumpets… for summoning the congregation and for journeying of the camps,”</t>
    <t s="44">to gather all of Israel together and for journeying and proceeding from strength to strength,</t>
    <t s="45">from a deep pit to a high roof,</t>
    <t s="46">and the matter of “when</t>
    <t s="47">you go to war,” war with the animal soul,</t>
    <t s="48">and you will be saved through subjugation and transformation,</t>
    <t s="49">and through this it will be “and you shall sound with trumpets before your G-d” in the third Holy Temple, which will be built very soon by our righteous Messiah,</t>
    <t s="50">and all this in the manner of “and on the day of your rejoicing,”</t>
    <t s="51">and “everlasting joy upon their heads,”</t>
    <t s="52">speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
